title: tavda-mail-parser output
description: The single JSON document that tavda-mail-parser writes to stdout for one message. Use this schema to validate or generate consumers of the output.

message_id.description: RFC 5322 Message-ID, wrapped in angle brackets.

sender.description: Sender address from the From header.

to.description: Primary recipient from the To header (first entry).

date.description: Message date normalized to UTC ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-09-12T10:00:00Z.

body.description: Decoded plain-text body; null when the message carries no text body.

document.description: Processing result for one attachment. The `status` tag selects the variant. `filename` and `content_type` mirror the declared headers (null when absent). `detected_content_type` is the canonical MIME type of the format actually used for decoding; it is present only when a decoder was picked (status `ok`, `error`) or the format was recognized (status `missing_decoder`), and never for `unsupported`. The `status` mapping is: `ok` = text extracted; `unsupported` = the format detection found nothing usable; `missing_decoder` = the format is recognized and supported but this host lacks the required decoder tool; `error` = extraction was attempted but failed.

decoder.description: Name of the missing decoder tool, e.g. `pdftotext` (Debian package `poppler-utils`).
